title: Autonomous
description: Build Left and Right autonomous routines from drive, turn and shoot commands, and pick them from a chooser.

checkpoints.title: Autos in the chooser
checkpoints.description: RobotContainer adds the Left Auto, Right Auto and Square Auto to the chooser.

checkpoints.title: Square auto uses a loop
checkpoints.description: squareAuto() builds the square with a for loop and a command group.

checkpoints.title: Left auto drives forward
checkpoints.description: Run Left Auto. The robot should travel more than 6 meters in x.

checkpoints.title: Left auto ends to the left
checkpoints.description: Run Left Auto. After turning 45 degrees, the robot should be more than 1 meter to the left (positive y).

checkpoints.title: Right auto ends to the right
checkpoints.description: Run Right Auto. After turning -45 degrees, the robot should be more than 1 meter to the right (negative y).

checkpoints.title: Autos shoot
checkpoints.description: Both routines should end by shooting at least once.
